scope: Final UI scenario visual review for existing 280 plus expansion 112; evaluates the icons actually present in the 21 scenario pages, not a claim that all 392 appear in scenarios.
method: Individually opened all 84 full screenshots through view_image, then independently reopened four updated table screenshots. No contact-sheet downscaling, no generated-image auto-approval. Initial PNGs frozen before root UI correction; visual findings written after inspection.
limitations: This is screenshot-based visual inspection; it does not independently certify browser interaction, keyboard use, screen-reader semantics or numeric contrast ratios.
Chromium/WebKit DPR 1/2 workflow verification belongs to the parent engineering report. These 84 PNGs are the supplied scenario evidence, not every browser/DPR combination.
Design visual acceptance and user final approval remain separate.
